shows.title: Finding Noah's Ark / Fractal Holographic Universe
shows.first_half: First Half: Biblical researcher Andrew Jones will share the latest developments surrounding his project at the Noah's Ark site in Durupınar, Turkey. With advanced geophysical investigations now underway, he'll tell us what the current evidence may reveal about the formation.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author and researcher Billy Carson will discuss the Fractal Holographic Universe: the idea that reality may be structured through self-similar patterns and nested scales. Billy will explore how fractals appear throughout nature and the human body, and how these concepts may intersect with quantum physics.

shows.title: AI-Driven Government Policy / Transformative Astrology
shows.first_half: First Half: Steve Goreham, executive director of the Climate Science Coalition of America, will discuss how US energy and financial policies are now being driven by artificial intelligence.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author and astrologer Aubrey Houdeshell will discuss the basics of astrology, how to use them to find the best places for success and love, and how to ultimately get more of what you want out of life. Her work mainly focuses on transformative and healing potential.

shows.title: Investigating Death / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Former Deputy Coroner Donna Francart will discuss the realities of death investigation, what her duties were as a coroner, the cases that defined her career, and how she endured years of grief, trauma, and gore. She'll talk about the spirits who followed her home long after she retired the badge, body bags, toe tags, and her pager. Followed by Open Lines—give George a call and discuss whatever's on your mind!
